title: 情報セキュリティ
subtitle: Information Security
educationalGoal: In this course, students will: (1) Learn an overview of information security technology and its necessity. (2) Learn basic knowledge of technologies such as cryptography and authentication. (3) Learn application systems such as antivirus, digital watermarking, and biometric authentication.
advice: This is a basic course on information security. The following materials will be covered: 1. Information security - overview of security technology 2. Cryptographic technology - common-key cryptosystem, and public-key cryptosystem 3. Authentication technology - hash function, digital signature 4. Security tools - client authentication, PKI, PGP, IPsec, TLS, and SSH 5. Application system - antivirus, countermeasures for unauthorized access, digital watermarking, and biometric authentication 6. Information ethics - ethical issues in information security
books: Textbooks: Reference books: None Reserved books: None
requiredKnowledge: Basic knowledge of information networks is required.
